description: This file defines the EmployeeDao class which provides data access methods for Employee entities within an HRM system. It includes functions for retrieving, saving, deleting employees, and related queries such as employee count, supervisor/subordinate relationships, and email validation.

classes.name: EmployeeDao
classes.description: A Data Access Object class for Employee entity management, providing methods for CRUD operations, relationship queries, and filtering functions.

methods.name: getEmployeeList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Employee entities based on provided search filters.

methods.name: getEmpNumbersByFilterParams
methods.description: Retrieves employee numbers matching the search filters, sorted by employee number.

methods.name: getEmployeeCount
methods.description: Returns the count of employees matching the search filters.

methods.name: saveEmployee
methods.description: Persists an Employee entity to the database.

methods.name: getEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Fetches an Employee entity by its employee number.

methods.name: getExistingEmpNumbers
methods.description: Retrieves employee numbers from a given list that exist in the database and are not purged.

methods.name: getSubordinateIdListBySupervisorId
methods.description: Recursively obtains subordinate employee IDs reporting directly or indirectly to a supervisor.

methods.name: getNumberOfEmployees
methods.description: Returns total number of employees, optionally including or excluding terminated ones.

methods.name: getSubordinateList
methods.description: Recursively retrieves subordinate Employee entities for a given supervisor.

methods.name: isSupervisor
methods.description: Checks if a given employee is a supervisor (has subordinates).

methods.name: getReportingMethod
methods.description: Fetches the reporting method details between a subordinate and supervisor.

methods.name: getEmpNumberList
methods.description: Returns a list of employee numbers for all non-purged employees, optionally excluding terminated.

methods.name: deleteEmployees
methods.description: Deletes employees specified by employee numbers.

methods.name: getSupervisorIdListBySubordinateId
methods.description: Recursively obtains supervisor employee IDs for a subordinate, considering the chain.

methods.name: getEmployeeWorkShift
methods.description: Fetches the work shift details for a specific employee.

methods.name: getAvailableEmployeeListForWorkShift
methods.description: Lists employees available for work shifts, filtered accordingly.

methods.name: getEmailList
methods.description: Retrieves email addresses of employees (work and other emails).

methods.name: isEmailAvailable
methods.description: Checks if an email address is already used by any employee.

methods.name: isUniqueEmployeeId
methods.description: Verifies if an employee ID is unique in the system.
